### Oh to Have Faith Like a Hebrew Midwife
Author: Kevin DeYoung
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/kevin-deyoung/oh-to-have-faith-like-hebrew-midwife/
Passage: Exodus 1:17
Points:
- The sharp contrast between verses 16 and 17 highlights the midwives' remarkable bravery against Pharaoh's royal decree.
- Shiphrah and Puah drew their strength not from self-confidence, but from fearing God more than the most powerful earthly ruler.
- People frequently cave to societal expectations, peer pressure, or fear of suffering because they fear humans more than God.
- Genuine fear of God is not dread of condemnation, but a deep reverence that hates sin and refuses to disobey Him.
- True spiritual courage and moral integrity arise only when displeasing God matters far more than disappointing people.

### A Chain of Courage - Encouragement for Today - April 15, 2016
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/a-chain-of-courage-encouragement-for-today-april-15-2016.html
Passage: Exodus 1:17
Points:
- Shiphrah and Puah chose to obey God rather than Pharaoh, sparking a generational chain reaction of bold faith.
- Their defiance inspired Moses' mother Jochebed to hide her child, and his sister Miriam to boldly approach Egyptian royalty.
- One person's decision to trust God and reject fear empowers others in their family and community to stand strong.
- Believers can cultivate spiritual boldness by studying courageous biblical figures, surrounding themselves with faithful peers, and praying for strength.

### Magnificent Multiplicity - Part 1 - God's Love at Work - Week of July 5
Author: Margaret D. Mitchell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/magnificent-multiplicity-part1-gods-love-at-work-week-of-july-5.html
Passage: Exodus 1:12
Points:
- Worldly oppression cannot halt God's sovereign plan to increase and establish His people.
- Even under intense affliction in Egypt, the Israelites multiplied, spread out, and caused their oppressors to fear them.
- When believers walk in godly alignment and obedience, worldly opposition loses its power to hold them back.
- Entrusting broken and painful seasons to the Lord allows Him to bring supernatural breakthrough and fruitfulness.
